Timeblends

Run, jump and swing a golden sword through fifteen factory rooms. Every room has new platforms, lowered floor and three kinds of factory robots. The camera follows you; run off either end to reach the next room.

Keys: ← → or A D to run, Space ↑ or W to jump, Z or Shift to swing the sword, hold X for 1.5 seconds to heal one head (costs 2/6 of the yellow bar; every 3 hits fill 1/6), S or ↓ to drop through a platform, Z or E at the forge in the last room to upgrade with parts (5% drop chance), Tab, Esc or the gear top right to pause, H to take damage, J to heal, [ ] to change room. Click the game first so it can read your keys.
